scenes.say: The champion is already known. So what is left to decide in Abu Dhabi?
Antonelli clinched in Mexico City and has four hundred and two points. Qatar and the Abu Dhabi finale on the sixth of December remain.
No sprints and no fastest lap point. So a driver can take fifty more points at most.
For second: Verstappen has three hundred and four, Hamilton two sixty-seven, Russell and Norris two sixty-four each.
Places two to six go to five drivers: Verstappen, Hamilton, Russell, Norris and Leclerc. Piastri is out of the fight.
In the constructors' table Ferrari lead Red Bull by seventy-seven points, and nine separate Red Bull and McLaren for third.
Ocon leaves Haas. Next year Camara and Bearman drive there, and the twenty twenty-seven grid is complete.

title: Abu Dhabi: what is still to be decided in the F1 season finale
